# SwachhataPukare Foundation

> A registered Section 8 non-profit organization in Jharkhand, India, dedicated to river rejuvenation, ecological water hyacinth upcycling, decentralized solar power, wastewater treatment (STP), and sustainable rural community empowerment.

## Mission & Purpose
SwachhataPukare Foundation operates at the intersection of ecological restoration and rural circular economy. We convert invasive aquatic weeds into handcrafted utility goods that generate dignified livelihoods for women's Self-Help Groups (SHGs), run continuous weekly river cleanups on the Subarnarekha and Kharkai rivers, install decentralized Japanese Johkasou sewage treatment plants (STP), deploy renewable solar micro-grids, and host community changemaker platforms like TEDxBistupur.

## Core Initiatives & Environmental Pillars
- [River Cleaning Drives](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/river-cleaning.html): Over 500+ weekly volunteer cleanup drives removing non-biodegradable waste along the Subarnarekha and Kharkai riverbanks in Eastern India.
- [Water Hyacinth Craft](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/water-hyacinth.html): Harvesting invasive water hyacinth (Eichhornia crassipes), sun-drying natural stems, and training rural women artisans to weave sustainable consumer utility goods.
- [Solar Power Systems](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/solar-power.html): Over 5,000 kW+ installed solar power capacity across schools, healthcare centres, and community facilities, displacing fossil fuel dependency.
- [Sewage Treatment (Johkasou STP)](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/sewage-treatment.html): Decentralized Japanese Johkasou wastewater treatment plants and dry waste material recovery to eliminate untreated runoff into river systems.
- [Rural Smart Village Centres](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/rural-smart-village-centres.html): Green village infrastructure hubs providing artisan production workshops, solar energy, skill training, and digital connectivity.

## Platform & Community
- [TEDxBistupur Platform](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/tedxbistupur.html): Independent TEDx platform in Jamshedpur with 68+ changemaker speakers driving environmental innovation and civic empowerment. Official external portal: https://www.tedxbistupur.org/
- [Field Stories & Blog](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/blog.html): Articles and field dispatches documenting river restoration methods, artisan circular economy stories, and sustainable village models.
- [Living Photo Archive](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/gallery.html): Field photography archives documenting river drives, craft making, and clean energy installations.

## Handcrafted Artisan Store & Catalog
- [Artisan Shop](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/shop.html): Online store featuring 100% natural, biodegradable water hyacinth lifestyle goods crafted by rural women artisans.
- [Corporate & Bulk Enquiries](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/bulk-enquiry.html): Customized water hyacinth conference kits, executive folders, seminar bags, and corporate gifting hampers.
- [Order Tracking](https://www.swachhatapukare.com/track.html): Real-time delivery and shipment tracking for online orders.
